issue.title: Vlan class id remains unaffected after 1 subport is removed

failure.body:
Steps
* Select 1 subport and remove it
(Remove all entries associated with that subintf from VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE table (there will be 3 keys - subintf, subintf |ip addr , subintf | ipv6 addr).
*  Send traffic between other subports

Expected result:
Traffic forwarding between other subports should work fine

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Test sub port stability if some other sub ports are removed.

#### How did you do it?
Add `test_routing_between_sub_ports_unaffected_by_sub_ports_removal` to cover this scenario that it will verify the testing sub port still routes packets if some other sub ports are removed.
